title: Multiple games, captures, game results and controls
steps: In play-opening play g1-f3; check board, turn, captures and history together.
Switch to play-mate and play d8-h4 for checkmate; inspect play-drawn and play-resigned.
Offer/accept/reject a draw, resign, take back and change a player in play-opening, resetting between destructive branches.
Switch between tabs, close all but one, then navigate to /game/missing-game. Use Close game to close the final workspace without deleting its saves.
